summary: Add explicit manual-return Snooze state and compatible read models before enabling writers

replay.detail: Optional indefinite on person.attention-snoozed is replayed into a fresh person_attention_controls_v2 projection. Every authoritative legacy seen and timed-snooze claim is replayed. Old projection data is retained but its ready marker is invalidated when controls change; a new open also rebuilds after an older runtime has marked its projection ready.

schema.detail: The derived control projection adds snoozed_indefinitely. Attention and control results add an optional read boolean that is emitted only when true; false is absent. The authoritative claim flag requires until_unix_ms null. Existing absent/false plus null still means bring back.

rules.detail: Adding the optional claim field changes Registry::digest and the schema_digest advertised by daemon.started. Checkpoint rules version, person authority, request lifecycle, notifications and deadlines remain unchanged. This expansion enables no new public write operation.

compatibility.detail: This reader expansion precedes manual-return writers. Legacy timed and clear read shapes remain exact because false is omitted. Older tolerant readers ignore the new true flag and can show an unanswered manual-return item as active; strict old readers reject it. Upgrade daemons and read clients before enabling manual-return writers. Older members retain replicated indefinite claims as retryable unknown-claim-field records until upgraded, so every member must upgrade before writers are enabled.

downtime.detail: No planned downtime. The derived control projection replays transactionally when the store opens.

manual.detail: The bundled TUI reads manual-return state, excludes it from active Now and triage without a wake time, and can bring it back through its existing control. No new public writer or CLI mode is enabled by this reader expansion.

recovery.detail: All claims are retained. Legacy-only timed and clear controls force the old projection to rebuild on downgrade, and the new projection replays after legacy writes on roll-forward. Before reverting a member that has accepted manual-return claims, bring those items back using an updated member; older readers do not represent manual-return state.
